matching: Match outputs by origin_refs sets, not action_id or free-text titles. Exactly the discovered committed outcomes must be present. All expectations are visible in the candidate task and sources.

checks.title: Required schema and handoff presence
checks.acceptance: Bounded safe JSON/text reads, field types, recognized enums, nonempty descriptions and next steps for live work; prose meaning is not certified.

checks.title: Commitment discovery and outcome boundaries
checks.acceptance: Exactly the ten independently derived origin-ref groups; no suggested/decision-only/invented work and no merged or split independent outcomes.

checks.title: Repeat handling and evidence provenance
checks.acceptance: Sufficient original, repeat, final-state and evidence references are retained. Explicit summaries may substitute for redundant evidence citations; unrelated or after-cutoff refs are rejected.

checks.title: Non-actions and cutoff exclusion
checks.acceptance: The unaccepted suggestion/offer, non-action decision and both after-cutoff lines are recorded with their proper dispositions.

checks.title: Grounded accountability
checks.acceptance: Identified owners match; Noor acceptance supersedes Zoe; Omar offer does not supersede Leena; unresolved Sam and unassigned glossary stay distinct.

checks.title: Local and unknown deadlines
checks.acceptance: Original source wording is preserved as a nonempty quotation; original source refs, date/time/timezone/resolution agree. Phrase punctuation or inclusion of surrounding date text may vary. The glossary event-relative timezone may be null or Europe/London, with calendar date/time remaining null.

checks.title: Reported state
checks.acceptance: Reported completion, explicit incompletion, in-progress work and cancellation are correctly attributed.

checks.title: Evidence state
checks.acceptance: Review differs from merge; invitation differs from execution; inaccessible trace, conflicting r5 reports and partial icon export retain their evidence limits.

checks.title: Immediate prerequisites
checks.acceptance: The drill depends on the scheduling action even though scheduling is already complete; no other action prerequisites are invented.

checks.title: Deadline-passed versus proven lateness
checks.acceptance: Local calendar/timed comparisons are correct and only the incomplete matrix is confirmed overdue.

checks.title: Source coverage and cutoff
checks.acceptance: Included/excluded records and cutoff agree; late correction and alleged earlier completion do not leak into admissible state.

checks.title: Specific unresolved questions
checks.acceptance: Expected identity, owner, date, missing-completion-evidence and conflict questions target the correct discovered action and valid relevant refs. Clarifications are required for live work; a grounded Android/date clarification is accepted but optional for the completed undated work.

limitations: No semantic claim is made about title, completion_condition, next_step, explanation, question, or handoff prose beyond schema/nonempty presence. A structurally correct but misleading prose artifact can pass objective checks; review it separately before real-world use.
This is one synthetic transfer fixture, not evidence of guide efficacy or external-service operation.
References are a constrained exact interface; natural-language equivalents are accepted only in free text, not source identifiers, person IDs or enumerations.
due_wording_rule: Check a nonempty case/punctuation-insensitive contiguous phrase from the original source line that includes a recognized original date expression; no exact prose match is required.
citation_rule: Each inner citation-options list is an any-of evidence alternative; satisfy every group. Additional relevant refs from the full oracle and allowed-extra sets are accepted. These choices deliberately accept source summaries that establish the same facts. No exact exhaustive source-ref set is required.
accounting: All 12 checks remain scheduled. Unsafe, unreadable or structurally invalid outputs fail T2-01; dependent checks remain unknown/unassessed. A trusted-package hash failure prevents grading and leaves every check unknown. Only 12 passes establish all-requirements-met.
revision_note: Pretrial independent author-review correction only: allow grounded optional completed-undated clarification, source timezone context for the undated event, finite float parsing, and fail-closed optimized author scripts. No candidate/model outcomes informed changes.
